primer: KORU is a 3x daily leveraged ETF that tracks the MSCI Korea 25/50 Index. Although its underlying Korean equity proxy EWY gained +33.40% over the trailing year, KORU lost -37.16% due to -8.43% to -8.65% negative carry and severe discrete variance drag. At the November 20, 2026 close of $4.76, KORU sits in Stage 4 and breached its prior $5.22 structural stop. We rate new capital REJECTED at TIER_0 and mandate EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 471.984153 Robinhood shares, holding 100% ($2,246.64) in CASH.
